title: AHP+ 1.4.0 stable candidate release gate
description: The exact stable source candidate passed the local release gate, six-job GitHub Actions matrix, and a from-zero consumer installation from its local tarball.
result: PASS: 34/34 core tests, 3/3 conformance, 253 validated files, 75 packaged files; Ubuntu/macOS/Windows on Node 20/22; clean tarball consumer reported 1.4.0, idempotent setup, strict PASS, and a valid causal Codex-Claude room reply
limitations: The tarball was installed locally before registry publication. GitHub tag, GitHub Release, npm latest publication, public-registry installation, native chat injection, idle wake, and cross-device UI delivery remain outside this evidence.
